name: Unitec
summary: Auckland institute on two campuses, Mt Albert and Waitakere, with career-focused bachelor's degrees from nursing and construction to design.

ib.text: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, with at least 4 in an English-rich subject and 4 in maths (or numeracy by other means); IELTS Academic 6.0 applies if English is not your first language.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Accounting
programmes.about: A three-year degree in accounting and finance principles, tax and business law, using software such as Xero and Power BI, with a final-year work placement. It meets the academic requirements for CA ANZ and CPA pathways.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Animal Behaviour and Welfare, and Biodiversity Management)
programmes.about: A double major that joins animal behaviour and welfare with biodiversity management, with courses on animal health and husbandry, behaviour modification, conservation and how ecosystems work.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Applied Science
family.differs: Both majors together: animal behaviour and welfare with biodiversity management.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Animal Behaviour and Welfare)
programmes.about: Covers animal health and husbandry, conservation, behaviour modification and human-animal interactions, preparing you for a career in the animal care sector.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Applied Science
family.differs: Single major in animal behaviour and welfare.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Biodiversity Management)
programmes.about: Explores how ecosystems support biological diversity and how managers respond to human impact, including the social, cultural and policy frameworks behind management decisions.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Architectural Studies
programmes.about: The first step towards an architecture career: drawing, design and graphic presentation, site analysis, environmental sustainability, building law and construction technology, with a Maori perspective on design.
programmes.selectionNote: No portfolio is required, though you can discuss one with lecturers. The July intake is open to domestic students only.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business (Management)
programmes.about: Builds management, leadership and problem-solving skills through hands-on projects: leading people, driving projects and contributing to an organisation's success.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Business
family.differs: Management major: leading people and projects.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business (Marketing)
programmes.about: Teaches consumer behaviour and marketing planning, with industry-based learning projects for organisations that match your specialisation.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Business
family.differs: Marketing major: consumer behaviour and marketing plans.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computing Systems
programmes.about: A three-year degree that builds professional adaptive skills for the computing industry, including developing and deploying software applications for mobile devices.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Construction (Construction Economics)
programmes.about: Trains quantity surveyors: estimating, evaluating subcontractor tenders, managing construction costs and cash flow, and agreeing final project accounts.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Construction
family.differs: Quantity surveying: costs, tenders and final accounts.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Construction (Construction Management)
programmes.about: Prepares you to organise and manage activities on a construction site, from management structures and supply chains to contract law and tendering.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Construction
family.differs: Managing activities on a construction site.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Construction (Property Development)
programmes.about: Follows property development from concept to sale, covering valuation, financing, portfolio management, procurement, tendering, and property and contract law.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Construction
family.differs: Developing property from concept to sale.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Design and Contemporary Art
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Design and Contemporary Art
programmes.about: A hands-on degree whose first year of discovery and experimentation leads to a specialist path in art and design, building technical skills through making.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry is by the IB equivalence or an art or design qualification at Level 4 or above; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology (Civil)
programmes.about: A three-year degree in civil engineering practice with pathways in environmental, geotechnical, water, roading and transportation, or structural engineering, plus computer modelling and project management.
programmes.ib: The entry list names Level 3 Physics and calculus-level Maths; ask Unitec how IB Physics and Maths count.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology
family.differs: Civil engineering practice and project management.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology (Electrical)
programmes.about: A three-year degree in electrical and electronic engineering with a specialisation in electronics, power or mechatronics, covering engineering computing, mechanics, mathematics and design.
programmes.ib: The entry list names Level 3 Physics and calculus-level Maths; ask Unitec how IB Physics and Maths count.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

family.name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology
family.differs: Electrical and electronic engineering: electronics, power or mechatronics.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Landscape Architecture
programmes.about: A four-year degree that joins science, technology, art and design to shape urban and rural environments, from urban design and transport infrastructure to waterfronts and coastal projects.
programmes.selectionNote: No portfolio is required, though you can discuss one with lecturers. The July intake is open to domestic students only.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Nursing
programmes.closesNote: As published for 2027 entry; ask about later intakes
programmes.about: A three-year degree to become a registered nurse, balancing theory and practice, with human biology, nursing skills and research-informed practice taught at the Waitakere campus.
programmes.ib: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and in every band if English is not your first language; a police vetting consent form is part of the application.
programmes.selectionNote: The page says applications for 2027 close on 30 November 2026; ask the admissions office about a July 2027 or later start.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts (Acting for Screen and Theatre)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts
programmes.about: Three years of training in voice, body and character, with accents, audition technique and the professional skills to work as an artist in screen and theatre.
programmes.ib: An audition is required; IELTS Academic 6.0 with no band under 5.5 if English is not your first language.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry is by audition; the first round is a video with a deadline in the second week of September each year.

family.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts

programmes.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts (Contemporary Dance)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts
programmes.about: A full-time dance degree covering contemporary dance, street dance, ballet, choreography, improvisation and professional practice such as self-employment and grant writing.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry is by audition, with group sessions in Auckland and Christchurch and other flexible options; instructions arrive when you apply.

family.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts

programmes.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts (Screen Arts)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts
programmes.about: Three years behind the camera: specialise in cinematography, editing, production, screenwriting or directing, with collaborative projects alongside the Acting and Dance students.
programmes.ib: An interview is required, with digital files or links to examples of your work.
programmes.selectionNote: You book a 20-minute interview when you apply and upload files or links to examples of your work.

family.name: Bachelor of Performing and Screen Arts
family.differs: Screen arts major, entered by interview.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Social Practice
programmes.about: A four-year degree preparing you for employment and registration in social work and community development, with basic counselling skills.
programmes.ib: A police vetting consent form is part of the application.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Teaching (Early Childhood Education)
programmes.about: A field-based degree for becoming an early childhood teacher: you work at least 12 hours a week in an early childhood centre and spend two days a week on campus.
programmes.ib: Applicants must be at least 17; a police check consent form is part of the application.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Veterinary Nursing
programmes.about: Builds on the Diploma in Veterinary Nursing: animal nursing fundamentals in year one, then voluntary registration and the clinical skills to work in a veterinary team.
programmes.selectionNote: Needs the IB equivalence (24 points, 4 in an English-rich subject and in maths) and the English requirement; no ranking is published.

notes: The three Applied Technology degrees, which name a trade certificate as their route, and Medical Imaging, closed for 2027, are not listed.
Unitec shows its international tuition as an approximate fee for 120 credits, which is one full-time year, and offers a grant of up to NZ$2,000 for 2027.
Architectural Studies and Landscape Architecture take international students in February only; the July intake is for domestic students.
